deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 29% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.8% = 10-year Treasury 4.8% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 87% last year; 51%/yr over 3 years — the market expects a slowdown from its recent pace.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: Not meaningful (the company holds more cash than its debt plus equity, or data is missing); return on shareholders' equity 33% (3 years ago 5%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $4.9B, up 88% from a year ago — about 0.7× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $1.2B, up 64% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Stock-based pay is 13% of sales — a real cost to shareholders that cash-flow figures leave out.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 51%/yr over 3 years and 38%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 46% vs a 5-year range of -27–46% (median 10%): near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back).

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: No buybacks or dividends reported over the last 12 months. Share count up 0.1% from a year ago (about flat).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $2.54, up 10% in 90 days (up 8% in the last 30); 3 analysts raised, 2 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $1.70, up 6% in 90 days (up 5% in the last 30); 0 analysts raised, 5 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +110% vs a year ago · $1.43 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 110% vs sales 96%: profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 8 quarters running by about 13%, yet the stock fell after 4 of them: beats are already expected.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.read: Sales up 96% from a year ago and speeding up (from 85% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Growth of quarterly sales (revenue) compared with the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $46 of operating profit, up from $22 a year ago: profitability is improving.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 110% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 113× last year's profit (its lowest in 5 years); only 63× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Feb 1; analysts expect EPS of $0.41, up 62% from a year ago. It usually moves about 12% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.

tiles.title: Forecast changes
tiles.read: Next year's EPS forecast is up 10% in 90 days (3 raised, 2 cut lately): forecasts are edging up.
tiles.explain: How the average analyst forecast for next year's earnings per share changed (Yahoo, unofficial).
